entry.title: Teacher Called Humble Pie
entry.summary: I wish I could convince you how lucky you are. To…
entry.content:
I wish I could convince you how lucky you are.

To be on the ground floor of the Maslow heirarchy.

Or at least, to have that floor satisfied.

Air to breathe.

Water to drink.

Food to eat.

Roof over head.

The ability to get a good night's sleep.

There's a line that goes "If you don't have your health, you don't have anything."

And that line has been on my mind of late.

I'm able to write, perhaps not nearly at my best (such as it was), but here I sits and types.

How lucky.

If I could, I would tell you more.

But privacy is privacy for a reason.

On the days and times I feel well enough, I will muster up a musing.

But until then, remember this:

What good is hitting the pinnacle of Actualization if you're struggling on the first floor?

So today's lesson is, to have everything, you have to first have your health.

First principles.

Life teaches the greatest lessons.

And I am learning every single second.

entry.title: Tungsten
entry.summary: Put your money where your mouth is. We all have heard…
entry.content:
Put your money where your mouth is.

We all have heard of that.

It means, back up your words with actions, hard work, and even dinero.

Well, I got something that might be more helpful.

Put your faith where your mouth is.

It's easy to have faith when things are going well, although we sometimes take it for granted.

But when things get tough (and they will, over and over, if you live long enough), when you have to back your faith up with actions, hard work, and yes even dinero, your faith is then truly tested.

Praising God is easy when things are going well.

When you're clearly blessed.

Healthy.

Loved.

Iterating to Actualization.

The truth is, even with all my trials and tribulations, I haven't gone through nearly the level of stuff some of you have. Or will.

Even this current T & T pales in comparison to some of your tests, past, present and future.

I wish I could protect you from all of it, but I can't.

And I think it'd do you a disservice.

Complacency and ruts come from comfort sometimes.

And I never want you to feel that way.

Contentment and peace, yes.

Grace is amazing.

Do you understand that?

I hope you do.

I know I do.

A couple weeks ago, the last thing I cared about was writing on this thing.

And I must admit, it's no longer a "must do".

But I just want to share, fights for yourself come on a lot of levels.

And I hope, I pray, you fight till the glorious end.

And remember, sometimes getting better is like the stock market.

Up, down, up, way down, up, way up, wayyyyyyyyy up.

You get the idea.

It's easy to see what you're made of when things are easy.

So what are you made of when things get hard?

entry.title: All Of This Is A Love Letter
entry.summary: When you get a note from your child that starts with…
entry.content:
When you get a note from your child that starts with "To the best daddy in the world," well it's enough to make a grown man cry.

I don't share this to brag.

At least about myself.

I'm not the best daddy in the world.

I'm sure there's one or two better.

I brag because of the heart of my children.

Of my family.

As a former loner, I never used to NEED anyone.

But I see that's no longer true.

If it ever was.

Praise God.

I need help.

From the people I love.

To do what they've always done since day one.

Take care of me.

As I have them.

An imperfect circle.

But one my mind has to come to grips with.

And not feel so ashamed about.

Let them help me.

Feel emboldened and empowered by their help.

And so that's the lesson for today.

Help others help you.

Love,

The luckiest daddy in the world (I am willing to share this title, dads).

entry.title: Instant Healing, Over Time
entry.summary: I'd like to think I'm tough. But I'm not. I'm not…
entry.content:
I'd like to think I'm tough.

But I'm not.

I'm not tough.

Yes, you are.

At least when compared to my loved ones.

Oh, sure.

Who have had to take care of me for so many years.

And have to do so again.

My children have stepped up and taken everything in stride.

Tough times make for tough people.

But no one's been stronger, is stronger, than my wife.

She's been with me through sickness and in health.

For richer and poorer.

And she's trying her best to get me to health.

As a man, it both crushes and strengthens me that she is working so diligently to keep everything as normal as possible considering the circumstances.

And they are kinda strange circumstances.

But such is my life.

So much of life requires physical toughness.

But so much more important is mental toughness.

Spiritual toughness.

So the thing I'd say is God is giving me the grace to write a little again, which implies so much beyond just the surface benefit.

I couldn't write for weeks.

Didn't even want to if I could.

And with my few words here I want to advise you to work on your mental and spiritual toughness.

And silver lining wise, that really can only happen when you're in the sheet.

A silver lining to the sheet.

So here we go again.

Day by day.

Hour by hour.

Inch by inch.

Let's see what I'm made of.

entry.title: Still Kicking
entry.summary: Crazy times. Going through something. I'd say more but I don't…
entry.content:
Crazy times. 

Going through something.

I'd say more but I don't want to.

Just weird stuff.

Thankful to still be walking the earth.

Albeit a bit more wobbly.

Thank you, God. 

I know you're teaching me something.

And I'm learning so much every day.

Please heal me.

If you are the type to pray, I sure could use yours.

entry.title: You Might Like
entry.summary: We live in a curated world. The things fed to us.
entry.content:
We live in a curated world.

The things fed to us.

Customized.

Targeted.

We'd think you'd like it'ed.

But how soon, walk with me, how soon before what we consume is completely unique?

Entire feeds.

Entire shows.

Entire albums.

Not just the curation.

The content.

Created from scratch.

All made for one person.

You.

Bespoken.

Is that possible?

YouTube literally for You.

Tube.

Generated on the fly.

"Hey, did you watch the newest episode of Blah?"

"Yeah, it was funny when they blahed."

"Oh, that didn't happen in my version."

Is that why it wouldn't happen?

Because you couldn't yap about it?

Because everyone gets something different?

Even if it's the same thing mostly?

I see these music videos of songs ai makes and I think, dang, that's pretty good.

Better than most sheet out by today's flesh and bone.

It's all formulas, you know.

Good stories.

Good shows.

Good songs.

There's a trick to all of them.

And tricks we can program.

One day, maybe.

You fire up the big screen.

And you see what's on.

And it'll be all stuff made just for you.

Based on what you've liked before.

And tweaked based on your feedback.

This human likes action comedies featuring a martial artist and a comedian.

Oooh, Rush Hour 79.3!

I hope it's better than 79.2!!!

Jackie the 3rd can't die in this one.

Next time, let's make it Chris Tucker Farley as the martial artist. 

Jackie as the comedian.

Could it be prompt media?

Vibe news?

Iterating ratings?

As an (inactive) attorney, the mind reels at the liabilities of such things.

Best assured I see dollar signs.

💰

It's like Napster days times infinity.

Take his whole library!!!

We are in the digital wild west days again.

And we're here for it.

Thank you.

Oh.

You should also read.

entry.title: Silly Questions Deserve Silly Answers
entry.summary: "What is wrong with you?" You know, I hear that a…
entry.content:
"What is wrong with you?"

You know, I hear that a lot.

Or at least I used to.

Now people either are used to it, or they gone.

Long gone.

Given the steel toe.

Booted off the existence of my reality.

Gone, baby, gone.

Don't let the door hit ya, fat arse.

Where was I?

Oh yes, the first hundred or so times I heard "What is wrong with you?" I would take it literally.

Nothing, I'd say or think.

Things are quite well, actually.

It takes some getting used to, you know.

Me.

What is right with you?

That's a finer question.

I think a blessed question.

For it lets me talk for hours.

But I don't like doing that.

Only a few minutes.

Via written word.

Sometimes, rarely, twice a day.

But usually only once.

Thanks for asking.

entry.title: I'm Not Saying It Was Aliens
entry.summary: Can I be a little crass? I mean, more than usual?…
entry.content:
Can I be a little crass?

I mean, more than usual?

Why we looking for Earhart's plane still?

That sheet went down eons ago.

Or was snatched by aliens.

I guess I just don't get it.

Who's footing the bill for the Earhart plane search?

Now I suppose if its family, well, then Godspeed.

Search for the plane all you want.

Get some closure.

But if it's like people who are still trying to crack the DB Cooper case.

Let it go.

Like Frozen.

Dan jumped out a plane with some cash and made it.

Or didn't.

Or got snatched up by aliens.

Of course, I say all this with cheek in tongue.

I don't really care what mystery you trying to solve.

It just seems like a weird win.

"We found the plane!"

Yay!

"We found Dan!"

Sorta.

But what did I say in one of these here musings?

You don't live life for others.

Be a weird winner.

You wanna find old skeletons of aviation devices and the folks who jumped from them?

Well by all means.

We can't all solve the meaning of life.

Can we?

And are these sleuths showing us the a way?

I don't know.

I'm busy.

Although, since we're sleuthing.

Whatever happened to all those missing boxes in Tesla's hotel room?

Seems like they would have some good reading in there.

And I don't need to tell you how much an old(ish) curmudgeon loves a good story.

👽

entry.title: Give Or Take
entry.summary: Are you a "me" or "we" person? Meaning, do you put…
entry.content:
Are you a "me" or "we" person?

Meaning, do you put yourself first or others?

Are you a solo artist or a part of an ensemble?

Folks usually align one of these two ways.

I'd say it's pretty gendered but it's just not always so.

Me folks focus on the self.

We folks focus on others.

Why?

Me folks want to improve themselves.

We folks want to improve others.

So here's the weird thing about this.

If you are a me folk, start focusing on the we.

If you are a we folk, start focusing on the me.

There is no better way to self-improve than to help other people.

And there is no better way to help other people than to take care of yourself first.

If you want to improve, help.

If you want to help, improve.

What do I know, though?

I've been helping you folks forever.

Still don't got abs.
